src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: 2011 Congressional Redistricting Plan, drawn by a special master and adopted by the Connecticut Supreme Court on Feb. 10, 2012 (the Reapportionment Commission missed its Nov. 30, 2011 deadline); 5 districts
Connecticut General Assembly, 2011 Redistricting Plans & Maps (Congress: adopted by the State Supreme Court 2/10/2012; House and Senate: approved by the Commission 11/30/2011)
Census cb_2020 cd116 file: 5 districts (116th Congress; unchanged until 2022).

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2011 State Senate Redistricting Plan, approved by the Reapportionment Commission on Nov. 30, 2011; 36 districts
Connecticut General Assembly, 2011 Redistricting Plans & Maps (Congress: adopted by the State Supreme Court 2/10/2012; House and Senate: approved by the Commission 11/30/2011)
Census cb_2020 sldu file: LSY 2018, 36 districts.
